subject: Aurora Health — Workspace & API access setup
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Alec Hayes <alec.hayes@auroramed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Aurora Health — Workspace & API access setup

Hi Alec —

Great to kick this off. Per our onboarding runbook, I want to confirm the initial plan for Aurora's workspace and API access so Monica and David can seed the org with the right projects, API keys, and admin roles. Quick summary of what we'll do in week 1: 

- Create primary workspace (namespace: aurora-prod) in us-west region
- Seed two admin API keys: one for Platform Ops (rotatable) and one for Integrations (read/write with limited scope)
- Create service accounts: integrations-service and analytics-service
- Invite initial admins (list below) and assign roles per attached role matrix
- Schedule a 30-min key handoff call once keys are seeded

Action items for Aurora: please confirm the following by EOD Tuesday so we can start seeding on Wednesday: 
1) Primary admin(s) for invites (name + corporate email)
2) Preferred project naming convention (we recommend aurora-core, aurora-analytics)
3) Do you want SSO (SAML) enabled in week 1 or post-launch?
4) Any required IP allowlists for API calls?

I attached a lightweight mutual action plan to make timelines explicit. Monica — once Alec confirms, please proceed with namespace creation and draft the two seed keys using the rotation template. David — you'll own role mapping and the invite cadence.

Thanks,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

Attachment: Aurora_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Alec Hayes <alec.hayes@auroramed.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Li <s.li@auroramed.com>, Contracts Team <contracts@auroramed.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Health — Workspace & API access setup

Thanks Jonas —

All good from our side. Answers inline: 
1) Primary admins: Samantha Li (s.li@auroramed.com) and Alec Hayes (alec.hayes@auroramed.com)
2) We'll use the convention: aurora-prod-core, aurora-prod-analytics (fine to use your suggested short names as aliases)
3) SSO: Prefer to enable SAML after we validate API flows (post-launch).
4) IP allowlist: we'll provide CIDR ranges for our integration VPC by Wednesday morning.

Also cc'd Contracts — we have one minor MSA redline (Section 6.2 around data retention). If you want to loop someone from Legal on your side, please do.

Appreciate the clear plan — happy for you to proceed with seeding on Wednesday once I send the IP ranges.

Best,
Alec

--
Alec Hayes
Head of Integrations | Aurora Health
alec.hayes@auroramed.com

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Aurora Health — Workspace & API access setup

Thanks Alec — noted. Monica, I'll template the role assignments based on the attached role matrix and then seed the following resources once we have confirmation: 

- Namespace: aurora-prod (region: us-west-2)
- Projects: aurora-prod-core, aurora-prod-analytics
- Service accounts: integrations-service (scoped to /api/v1/integrations/*), analytics-service (read-only for logs + metrics)
- Admin API keys: ops-admin-key (rotatable) and integrations-key (expires in 365d by default, can be set to 90d on request)

I'll prepare the api_key_rotation_template.txt and put the seed keys into a secure share for Samantha and Alec. After seeding, we'll create a short runbook for key rotation and invite schedule.

Tickets I'll open (internal): 
- OPS-847: create aurora-prod namespace + projects
- OPS-848: seed service accounts + keys (store in secure vault, send one-time link)
- OPS-849: invite admin users and verify roles

Planning note: if they enable SSO later, we'll coordinate user de-provisioning sync.

-David

David Kim

Thanks Alec — we have everything we need to proceed safely. Summary of next steps and timings: 

1) Wednesday 2026-09-25 09:00 PT — Namespace + projects created (OPS-847 completed).
2) Wednesday 2026-09-25 14:00 PT — Seeded service accounts and one-time key delivery (OPS-848). We'll deliver keys via a secure one-time link and include the rotation instructions.
3) Thursday 2026-09-26 10:00 PT — Admin invites sent to Samantha and Alec (OPS-849). Please accept and confirm role mapping so we can lock scopes.
4) Thursday 2026-09-26 15:00 PT — Short handoff call (30 min) to walk through the runbook and verify integration endpoints. Calendar invite to follow.

Notes: 
- We've set integrations-key scope to exclude known PII endpoints by default; when you share the precise endpoints to block, we'll harden the policy.
- Attachments: Aurora_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (updated), api_key_rotation_template.txt (finalized), redwood-admin-role-matrix.pdf (finalized).

If anything changes on your side (IP ranges, admin list, or legal hold), flag here and we'll pause the specific step until cleared. Otherwise we'll proceed on the times above.

Heading into the handoff call, our ask is: confirm admin acceptance on Thursday morning and provide the final list of PII endpoints for exclusion.

Thanks,
Monica

--
